Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a medieval king turning his empire's aesthetic into a proto-vaporwave   The response should include at least 39 pronouns.assistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing. This kingdom needs a new aesthetic.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER PIPER, approaches the king.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I'm tired of the same old suits of armor and banners. I want something new, something... futuristic.

JESTER PIPER
Futuristic, Your Majesty? But we're in the Middle Ages!

KING REGINALD
Exactly! That's what I mean. We need to break free from the shackles of tradition.

JESTER PIPER
I see what you mean, Your Majesty. But what exactly do you have in mind?

KING REGINALD
I want to incorporate more... synths. And neon lights. And... and... (he consults a small notebook)... VHS tapes.

JESTER PIPER
(stunned)
VHS tapes, Your Majesty?

KING REGINALD
Yes! We'll hang them from the castle walls, and play them on loop. It'll be like a never-ending video montage of our kingdom's history.

JESTER PIPER
(skeptical)
I'm not sure that's the best idea, Your Majesty.

KING REGINALD
Nonsense! It'll be a game-changer. (he turns to a nearby knight) Sir Edward, I want you to start designing some new armor. Something with... (he consults his notebook again)... pixelated patterns.

SIR EDWARD
(confused)
Pixelated patterns, Your Majesty?

KING REGINALD
Yes! And make sure it's in a pastel color scheme. We want to evoke a sense of... (he searches for the right word)... nostalgia.

SIR EDWARD
(nodding)
I understand, Your Majesty.

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors, LORD THOMAS and LADY ISABELLA, enter the throne room, looking concerned.

LORD THOMAS
Your Majesty, we have some... issues with the new aesthetic.

KING REGINALD
What do you mean?

LADY ISABELLA
Well, the pixelated armor looks... strange. And the VHS tapes are... (she shudders)... disturbing.

KING REGINALD
Nonsense! It's a bold new direction. (he gestures to a nearby servant) Bring me some... (he consults his notebook once more)... cassette tapes.

SERVANT
Yes, Your Majesty.

The servant returns with a stack of cassette tapes, which the king begins to play on a nearby boombox.

KING REGINALD
(to his advisors)
See? Isn't this wonderful?

LORD THOMAS
(awkwardly)
Yes, Your Majesty. It's... quite something.

LADY ISABELLA
(whispering to Lord Thomas)
I think we're in trouble.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a surreal, dreamlike landscape. Knights in pixelated armor ride by on horseback, while peasants scurry about, listening to VHS tapes on boomboxes. The king, resplendent in his neon-lit armor, sits on his throne, surrounded by a halo of... (he consults his notebook once more)... glow sticks.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
This is it. This is the future of our kingdom.

FADE TO BLACK.
